Our Story

Where healing meets creativity.

Our StoryCommunityArt & HealingEst. 2023ThohoyandouOur StoryCommunityArt & HealingEst. 2023Thohoyandou

The Beginning

A sanctuary for creativity.

Artsy Escape was founded upon a singular belief: that healing and joy are found through creativity and human connection. In a world where isolation has become commonplace, we envisioned a sanctuary where art transcends the canvas — becoming therapy, reconnection, and shared laughter.

What began as intimate sip-and-paint gatherings has grown into a creative movement — curating events that blend art, community, and wellness across Thohoyandou and beyond.

Healing does not always look like sitting across from a professional. Sometimes, it is in picking up a paintbrush.

By the Numbers

Our impact.

Through our experiences, we have witnessed confidence bloom, friendships form, and individuals discover a safe space to simply be themselves.

Our Values

What we stand for.

We believe art is for everyone — not just those who call themselves artists. Every brushstroke is an act of courage, every session a step toward wholeness.

We are proudly rooted in Thohoyandou, creating experiences that celebrate our community, our culture, and our shared capacity for joy and beauty.

Gift Kits

Five ways to escape.

From a first brushstroke to the ultimate luxury art experience — each kit is composed to deliver the full Artsy Escapes encounter, beautifully presented.

01

Starter

"First Stroke" Escape Kit

  • Mini canvas (A5)
  • 4 acrylic paints
  • 2 brushes
  • Paper palette
  • Instruction card
  • Thank-you card
02

Creative

"The Masterpiece" Kit

  • Canvas (A4)
  • 6–8 acrylic paints
  • 3 brushes
  • Palette & wipes
  • Apron
  • Step-by-step guide
  • Theme card
03

Children's

"Little Artist" Escape Kit

  • Pre-drawn canvas outline
  • Child-safe paints
  • 3 chunky brushes
  • Apron
  • Stickers
  • Treat (choice)
04

Couples

"Paint & Pour" Couples Kit

  • Two canvases
  • Two brush sets
  • 2 disposable aprons
  • Painting guide
  • Bouquet of flowers
  • Mini candles
  • A bottle of wine
05
Luxe

"The Golden Escape" Luxe Kit

  • Large canvas (A3)
  • 12–18 colour paint set
  • High-quality brush set
  • Sketchbook & palette
  • Apron
  • Gold-foil affirmation card
  • Mini self-care kit
  • Dried flower bundle
  • Premium gift box with ribbon

Enquiries

Frequently asked questions.

Should your enquiry remain unanswered below, please contact us directly.

Not at all. Artsy Escapes welcomes participants of all skill levels — from absolute beginners to accomplished artists. Our facilitators ensure an inclusive and encouraging environment for everyone.
Guests need only bring themselves and their enthusiasm. All materials — paints, brushes, canvases, and aprons — are provided on the day.
Indeed. We offer fully personalised events for private groups, birthday celebrations, hen parties, and corporate team-building. Please contact us to discuss tailoring an experience to your requirements.
Reservations may be made by reaching out via email or through our social media channels. Our team will be pleased to guide you through each step of the booking process.
Absolutely. All works created during our events belong to their creators and are taken home at the conclusion of the experience.
